meta.title: telemeSYNC · Your bike ride telemetry over your videos
meta.description: telemeSYNC is a free program that syncs your bike computer telemetry (FIT/GPX) with your action cam videos and creates transparent overlays: speed, gradient, map, elevation, heart rate and panels.
hero.eyebrow: Free · Windows and macOS · Program in Portuguese
hero.title: Your bike ride telemetry, right over your videos.
hero.lead: telemeSYNC syncs your bike computer file (FIT or GPX) with your action cam clips and creates transparent graphics: speed, gradient, map, elevation, heart rate and complete panels. Drag them into your video editor and you are done.
hero.check1: Your videos never leave your computer
hero.check2: Nothing to install: extract and open
hero.alt: Example of a telemeSYNC composition: speed, gradient, ride map and speed panel with the elevation chart of the last 10 km.
hero.caption: A real composition exported from a ride, over an illustrative landscape.
how.title: How it works
how.s1text: Load the FIT or GPX file from your bike computer. You get the ride summary and the available metrics.
how.s2text: Drag in all the videos from the ride. The camera and the time of each clip are detected from the metadata.
how.s3text: Check the alignment on a timeline with the video and live graphics. One adjustment per camera aligns every clip.
how.s4text: Transparent videos as long as each clip: one per gadget or everything in a single composition.
backers.title: Help telemeSYNC keep going
backers.lead: telemeSYNC is free and will stay free. Every coffee and every sponsorship pays for development time: more cameras and bike computers, new gadgets and ever better exports.
coffee.title: Buy me a coffee
coffee.text: A one-off contribution of any amount, through Buy Me a Coffee. It takes a minute and really makes a difference.
coffee.fine: Voluntary contribution, with nothing in return. Not a tax-deductible donation.
sponsor.title: Sponsor the project
sponsor.text: Advertising your company here supports the project and its ongoing development. Bike shops, gear brands, cycling events and outdoor tourism companies reach people who film and share their rides.
sponsor.fine: Terms by email. Sponsorships are always labelled as such.
sponsors.title: Sponsors
layers.title: The layers
layers.lead: Each gadget is exported as a video with a transparent background. Choose the metrics, colours and gradient, then place them in your editor or let telemeSYNC build the composition.
layers.panelsText: Gauge, maximum, average, zone or acceleration, and a chart of the last 10 min or 10 km. The chart can show another metric.
shot.painel-velocidade: Speed, with the elevation chart of the last 10 km
shot.painel-velocidade.alt: Speed panel with gauge, maximum and average speed, acceleration and elevation chart of the last 10 km.
shot.painel-fc.alt: Heart rate panel with the current zone and a chart of the last 10 minutes.
shot.painel-altitude.alt: Altitude panel with a green and blue gradient, maximum, minimum and total climb.
shot.painel-temperatura.alt: Temperature panel with minimum, maximum and change.
shot.mapa.alt: Map of the ride route with the part already covered highlighted.
shot.perfil.alt: Elevation profile of the ride with the current position.
shot.texto-grade.alt: Gradient gadget in percent, with a colour indicator.
shot.texto-heartRate.alt: Heart rate gadget coloured by zone.
demo.title: Demo
demo.lead: From the bike computer file to the final video in a few minutes.
demo.credit: Video courtesy of Alves na Roda · YouTube · Instagram
demo.fine: The preview image comes from YouTube; the video itself (privacy-enhanced mode) only loads when you press play.
download.title: Download
download.lead: · free · nothing to install. The program is in Portuguese for now.
download.step1: Download and extract the ZIP (right click → Extract All).
download.step2: Double-click Iniciar telemeSYNC.bat. The program opens in your browser.
download.step3: Keep the black window open while you use the program.
download.macReq: macOS 11 or later · Apple Silicon (M1 to M4) and Intel · about 155 MB
download.mac1: Download the ZIP. Safari opens it by itself and leaves the telemeSYNC folder in Downloads.
download.mac2: Double-click Iniciar telemeSYNC.command. The first time, allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
download.mac3: Keep the Terminal window open while you use the program.
download.fine: By downloading you accept the terms of use in the LICENCA.txt file.
roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.lead: What I am working on right now.
roadmap.i1text: Fewer manual tweaks: aligning clips with the telemetry more reliably, on more cameras.
roadmap.i2: Better export formats and smaller files
roadmap.i2text: Lighter files that work with more video editors.
roadmap.i3text: More panel styles and new gadgets to show your telemetry.
news.title: What's new
news.100.1: Mac version: a single download for Macs with Apple Silicon (M1 to M4) and Intel, macOS 11 or later. As on Windows, nothing to install.
news.100.2: First stable version: Windows and Mac with the same features — telemetry, sync, gadgets, panels and export with transparency.
news.100.3: The update notice and the website link to the right download for your system.
news.032.1: Update notice: when it starts, the program tells you when a new version is out, with links to what’s new and to the download. Without internet, it opens as usual.
news.032.2: For every kind of ride: road, gravel, MTB, downhill… the program’s texts no longer talk only about mountain biking.
news.031.1: Files up to 10× smaller: the default format is now QuickTime Animation (.mov, lossless). A 21-minute Full HD composition goes from about 19 GB to about 1.8 GB.
news.031.2: Choice of export format: QuickTime Animation, ProRes 4444, FFV1 (.mkv, for DaVinci Resolve), WebM VP9 (experimental) and PNG sequence, showing which editors keep the transparency.
news.031.3: 30 fps maximum: with 50/60 fps clips, overlays can be exported at half the frame rate (half the size) while staying aligned with the video.
news.031.4: Panels at the pace of the numbers: the gauge and the chart update with the numbers, making panel files about 3× smaller and faster to render.
news.030.1: Panels: gauge, ride stats and recent chart for speed, power, heart rate, cadence, temperature, altitude and gradient.
news.030.2: Two-colour gradient of your choice, adjustable background and power zones from your FTP.
news.030.3: Each panel’s chart can show another metric, over the last minutes or kilometres.
news.030.4: Fixed: exporting failed in the Windows version.
news.020.1: Welcome page, legal notices and support link.
news.020.2: FIT files read with an in-house decoder.
author.title: Made by Gabriel Pereira
author.text: telemeSYNC was born from bringing two passions together: mountain biking and well-made digital work. It is the same care I put into projects for companies and professionals: websites and landing pages, product design and development, automation and digital strategy. More than 20 projects delivered, in Portugal and abroad, including the website, online shop and bike rental of ViaBike, on the Camino de Santiago.
author.text2: telemeSYNC is freeware. If you need a website or a digital project, have a look at my services.
